decisions.reason: Using the supplied images without extra text resolves the article-end filler choice but does not change the magazine's overall layout inputs, action, or Flat Plan basis.
The decision not to add filler text does not change the approved Inter typeface, weight, or readability constraint.
The filler-content decision does not affect where red may be used.
Confirming that only the provided filler images are available does not alter the requirement to remediate poor image quality when necessary.
Using images rather than extra filler text does not change the polished, modern, brand-aligned visual-style requirement.
The source resolves filler content for the current issue and does not cancel or modify word-count guidance for future issues.
The absence of additional filler text does not change the specified source of magazine articles.
The filler-content decision does not alter article category labels, their sources, placement, or presentation.
The decision to use supplied filler images without extra text does not affect inclusion or placement of the cover-listed articles.
The filler-content choice does not change the table-of-contents completion timing or page-number accuracy requirement.
The supplied images referenced as article-end filler are not advertisements, and the source does not modify advertisement sharpness requirements.
The article-end filler decision does not change the requirement for accurate article page numbers on the cover.
